rationale: The text explains browse-abandonment email triggering by the abandoned page/product, but separately includes personalized recommendations and dynamic coupons without stating how they are selected. No AI is affirmed; non-AI is the best-supported forced choice, with weak evidence due to that unexplained functionality.
evidence_spans: Browse abandonment emails are automatically generated and sent to the visitor based on the specific page/product the visitor has abandoned.
Browse abandonment emails are highly personalized and include relevant personal product recommendations, personal dynamic coupons and more.
conflict_response: I distinguish the explicit page/product-triggered email automation from the additional recommendations and coupons. The latter could be generated by conventional rules or another method; the description establishes neither and does not authorize deterministic-rule assumptions, so the non-AI decision is weak/forced.
